title: Count Increasing Quadruplets
summary: Given a permutation nums of length n, count index quadruplets i < j < k < l with nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j] < nums[l].
officialConstraints: Permutation of 1..n; length up to 4000 (from search summary). Visualization cap: 4 to 12 elements.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps are listed in constraints; the DP table is shown in an 8 by 8 window that follows playback.
examplesNotes: No example inputs or outputs were retrieved from a source. Example outputs were checked by brute force, not from the statement.
